idea.why: Anticipate that China and India will accelerate near-shoring to bypass potential 40% tariffs, while the EU may seek deeper integration with Asia to mitigate supply chain fragmentation. Trump's repeated tariff threats have rattled Asian markets, yet investors are already pricing in a 'shrink-wrap' scenario where trade deals are finalized quickly to avoid penalties.
